n.<leader>ay: AI: yank current line to clipboard
n.<leader>aY: AI: yank whole buffer to clipboard

n.]r: Review: next file in panel order
n.[r: Review: previous file in panel order
n.<leader>aa: Review: ask about the current line

n.gd: Diffview LSP: definition at this commit
n.K: Diffview LSP: hover at this commit
n.grr: Diffview LSP: references at this commit
n.<C-t>: Diffview LSP: return from source jump
